description: Review round 2 of stoa-90tpd implementation after round 1 fixes.
notes:
Round 2 SEC1 review: banner extraction and guard standardization fixes all correctly applied. emit_startup_banner present in core/src/env.rs and re-exported from lib.rs. All 5 daemon main.rs files call stoa_core::emit_startup_banner identically with CARGO_PKG_NAME/VERSION — no inline banner blocks remain. One pre-existing P1 duplication NOT fixed by round 1: sigterm() is copy-pasted verbatim in all 5 binaries (reader, mail, smtp, imap, transit main.rs). This is a maintainability risk: any fix to SIGTERM handling (e.g. adding a timeout, changing SignalKind) must be applied in 5 places. Should be extracted to stoa_core or a shared binary utility. Maintainer risk: LOW for banner (fixed), MEDIUM for sigterm duplication (pre-existing, not introduced by round 1 fixes).
Confidence: 4% chance of missed bug. All four targeted files verified clean: (1) util.rs — is_loopback_addr handles bare IP, host:port, bracketed IPv6, and 'localhost'; is_loopback_url_host strips scheme and port correctly; both have independent-oracle unit tests. (2) env.rs — RuntimeEnvironment defaults to Production (fail-safe); is_dev() covers Development and Test; emit_startup_banner logs at warn in dev/test. The comment explicitly states STOA_ENV does NOT bypass security guards. (3) sieve_admin.rs — no duplicate implementations found; single start_sieve_admin_server entry point with correct fail-closed logic (non-loopback AND no token AND no allow_non_loopback flag); run_admin_server is a private inner function. Full test coverage of all three branches confirmed. (4) reader/main.rs lines 335-361 — signing_key_path guard and auth dev-mode guard both appear BEFORE TcpListener::bind at line 409. Ordering is correct. Epic stoa-90tpd shows 10/10 children closed. Round 1 fixes are all in place. Residual risk is low: env var tests use set_var without a Mutex (data-race if tests ever run in parallel), which is a known Rust test hazard, but already noted in code comments. Running out of real complaints: yes.
title: Review round 2: Dev mode startup guard (stoa-90tpd)
